prompt_text: Use case: stylized-concept. Create bg_skyline_mid revision 2 as an isolated transparent PNG parallax layer for a 2D side-view fighting game. Supplied art/concept/lote01/ui_tela_gameplay_hud.png is the style reference only: cel-shaded anime architecture, dark #15101C outlines, warm golden-hour light from left and cool violet shadows. Request highest native resolution supported, ideally 3840x2160 in 16:9 and never less than 1536 on longest edge. Original Nova Aurora city: skyscrapers with curved pagoda crowns and lantern-lit balconies, elevated monorail with a clear streamlined train, neon signage made of illegible abstract shapes, flowering cherry trees between buildings, original Pacific-coast/Tokyo fusion. Frontal orthographic view, medium-distance layer, rich precise architecture, lower saturation than playable fighters. Flat continuous bottom edge at the canvas bottom. Actual transparent alpha sky above and between silhouettes; clean antialiasing without colored contamination; if transparency is impossible, flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no gradient and no shadow. No painted sky, no clouds, no sun, no people, no HUD, no readable text or real logos, no copied movie landmarks. masterpiece-level key art quality, highly detailed, crisp clean linework, rich layered lighting with warm golden-hour key light and cool shadows, detailed background depth, no blur, no smudged details, no AI artifacts, no melted shapes SELF-REVIEW CORRECTION: The first output had red and blue alpha-edge contamination. For this single regeneration use the expressly allowed fallback: fully OPAQUE uniform pure magenta #FF00FF sky, with crisp clean building silhouettes, no alpha cutout processing, no red/blue fringes, no gradients in the magenta background. The game pipeline will remove the magenta later. Retain all original city-layer design constraints.

final_findings: Persistem franjas coloridas nas silhuetas; fallback magenta uniforme não foi atendido.
